chapter: Long Island years and Battle's estate
title: Playing Moby Dick's on Long Island
summary: He played trombone and guitar at Moby Dick's near Jones Beach with Slick Jones and his brother, a packed place that burned down.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yeah. So what's happened -- then, that's when I went to gigging around in Moby Dick's with the band with Slick Jones and my brother and all that.
Moby Dick's? Where is that?
That was in Long Island, about five miles from Jones' Beach.
Oh, and who did you have there with you?
Slick Jones --
Yeah.
-- and my brother.
Which one?
Piano player.
Roosevelt.

And Jimmy Wright was out there quite often and somebody else, regular with us. Oh, yeah. And a lot of times, I didn't play. guys out there in my place like Cecil Scott, Doc Cheetham. So finally, I built that place into (inaudible) out there, and so (inaudible) people.
You did play though?
Yeah.
Well, what instrument did you play out there?
I played trombone and guitar.
I wasn't quite sure whether at one time you dropped the guitar.
No, I never did drop the guitar. Always had a guitar, yeah.
I see.

Because I didn't want to play too long on either one of them. I promoted the place for the fella and it got to be, only competition they had was Jones' Beach. We was the only competition to Jones' Beach. That's the kind of crowd we had there. Had big parking lots, but it didn't take care of it, so had a lot of trouble with the police departments. Sergeant would come out and say you got to do something about this crowd. Come out here and look. People are backed up two miles, can't get by on the highway for your cars.
(Laughter.)
You know, guys trying to back out and his (inaudible).
How big a place was it?
Big place, big place. Then they enlarged it and enlarged it and I stayed there until it burned down. It caught on fire. That place was packed (inaudible).
Well, he must have done well with it but did you make much?
